description: Find out what an x402 endpoint will charge before you pay it. Probes the endpoint, reads the challenge from the header or the body, and returns the decoded price, network, asset and payTo plus the declared input and output schemas. Never sends a payment. Only reviewed origins are reachable, and a redirect is refused rather than followed. Pay 4000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

body.description: Optional JSON body to send with a POST probe.

method.description: Method to probe with. Defaults to GET.

url.description: HTTPS URL of an x402 endpoint on a reviewed origin. Credentials, ports and fragments are refused.

name: x402_endpoint_preflight

challenge.description: The decoded payment challenge, or null when the endpoint served none.

challenge_source.description: header or body, depending on where the endpoint put the challenge.

payment_sent.description: Always false. This service never pays the endpoint it probes.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: x402 Endpoint Preflight
